context: A coach motivates a teen athlete before the championship
purpose: Teach: 兼/収め/カッコ/役に立つ/世界一/珍しく/的確/なるべく

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: リク、今日はコーチ兼メンタルアドバイザーとして話すぞ。
lines.en: Riku, today I'm talking to you as both coach and mental advisor.
lines.style: Firm authoritative coach voice with steady measured pacing throughout.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: はい…正直、珍しく手が震えてるんです。
lines.en: Yes... honestly, unusually for me, my hands are shaking.
lines.style: Nervous teenage voice, slightly trembling and quieter than usual.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 落ち着け。お前の的確なフォームは誰よりも美しい。
lines.en: Calm down. Your precise form is more beautiful than anyone's.
lines.style: Reassuring deep tone, slow and grounding like an anchor.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: でも世界一の選手たちが揃ってるんですよ、コーチ。
lines.en: But the world's top athletes are all gathered here, coach.
lines.style: Anxious adolescent voice rising at the end with worry.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: だからこそだ。なるべく相手を見ず、自分の呼吸に集中しろ。
lines.en: That's exactly why. As much as possible, ignore them and focus on your breathing.
lines.style: Commanding but warm, like a mentor sharing hard-won wisdom.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今までの練習って、本当に役に立つんでしょうか…
lines.en: Will all the training up until now really pay off...?
lines.style: Self-doubting teen voice, voice cracking with vulnerability.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 現に去年も同じ不安で優勝を収めただろう。お前はカッコいい男だ。
lines.en: In fact, you won last year's title with the same anxiety. You're a cool guy.
lines.style: Proud paternal voice, smiling through the words with conviction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: …ありがとうございます、コーチ。行ってきます！
lines.en: ...Thank you, coach. I'm heading out there!
lines.style: Resolved teen voice gaining strength, ending with bright determination.
